frep.vat.boxes.output_acquisition_eu.lab.value: Acquisition VAT payable, purchases from other EU countries (reverse charge)

frep.vat.boxes.output_acquisition_non_eu.value: Acquisition VAT payable, purchases from outside the EU (reverse charge)

legal.public_holidays.source.value: halvaro_gen.calendar_ rules (computed), VERIFY against official calendars

policy.access.pay_visibility.value: row level pay only for the HR role, others get aggregates above the minimum cohort

policy.ageing.buckets.value: not due, 1 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 to 90, over 90 days past due

policy.approval.call_off_exemption.value: an order placed as a call-off on an active supplier framework contract is counted against the buyer's limit with and without the exemption, and the exemption itself is not decided

policy.calendar.board_months.value: February, March, June, September, November, December

policy.certificates.booked_renewal_count.value: report on record and including booked separately, a booking covers from its course date

policy.certificates.candidate_rules.value: skill level 2 to list, 3 to be plausible, country scope match, prerequisite valid, no long leave in the 90 days after start, not fully planned elsewhere, a seat before start plus 60 days

policy.corpus.code_pointer_contract.value: adopt the code field of the document front matter and the two way check of halvaro-core.md 4.2, checked in the CI of the corpus

policy.delivery.blocked_project_definiti.value: an active project is blocked when it has an open reservation of a critical item that is needed within the horizon (parameter inventory.yaml#critical_supply.blocked_need_horizon_days) and the stock of that item at the central site is zero or less; the unmet quantity is the open reservation quantity

policy.delivery.comparable_rule.value: profile de_clay_window: country DE, type dh_network, soil_class clay, status completed, route 4000 to 7500 m inclusive, legacy projects included and flagged

policy.delivery.contingency_method.value: advice only: the ground cause share of delay days times the schedule deviation quantile, net of the CST-830 allowance line, shown with n and the legacy count, and no percentage is hard coded

policy.delivery.executive_escalation.value: a delay finding has reached an executive when an executive of the executive roles is recorded present at a meeting of the project; the gap is the days from the first record of the delay to the first meeting with a present executive, counted from the first record

policy.delivery.executive_roles.value: Managing Director GmbH,Chief Operating Officer,Director Project Delivery,Director Engineering,Commercial Director,Chief Financial Officer,Chief Executive Officer

policy.delivery.first_record_rule.value: the first site diary row of a project with delay_seq 1, linked to a delay event and a meeting

policy.delivery.lead_time_alert.value: a lead time alert is raised when the lead time of a supplier and item rises by at least 8 weeks and at least 25 percent against the previous valid row; normal drift is minus 2 to plus 3 weeks

policy.delivery.minimum_stock_rule.value: minimum on hand is the demand during the lead time plus 2 weeks, reorder up to the minimum plus 6 weeks of demand, floor 1; critical items are the inventory.item.critical flag, not an id list

policy.delivery.overrun_definition.value: schedule deviation is the days between actual end and planned end over the planned days plus one, per completed project, and cost deviation is a separate measure: final cost over the tender estimate total minus one, full projects, contract currency

policy.delivery.supplier_on_time_rule.value: a line is due when its requested date is on or before the date and on time when the accepted quantity has reached the ordered quantity within 2 days after the requested date; lines of cancelled orders are left out; a window share is lines on time over lines due, never an average of monthly percentages

policy.delivery.supplier_risk_bands.value: high risk below 75 percent on time share over the window, medium from 75 to below 90 percent, low from 90 percent; the high band is the flag of policy.delivery.supplier_low_on_time_percent

policy.delivery.win_rate_definition.value: won over decided (won plus lost) by period of the decision and tier; withdrawn and open opportunities are not decided

policy.esg.baseline_recalculation.value: recalculate the 2023 baseline on the current factor set before measuring targets (today 2023 is not restated)

policy.esg.biogenic.value: report biogenic CO2 of HVO separately, outside the scopes, once a factor exists

policy.esg.customer_limit_boundary.value: the four project components (materials, transport, site fuel, subcontractors) per route metre; the customer's own definition is not in the data

policy.esg.customer_limit_handling.value: treat the limit as a bid condition: show median, gap, variants and two levers, sign-off by the Commercial Director and the sustainability lead, never promise below the lever supported figure

policy.esg.data_request_sla.value: answer within 35 days of receipt, 14 days for tender requirements

policy.esg.energy_audit_cycle.value: use 4 years only as a planning assumption until the law knowledge bases confirm duty and cycle (VERIFY for Germany and Denmark)

policy.esg.estimates_travel_commuting.value: keep 3.6 and 3.7 as labelled estimates until a data source exists

policy.esg.factor_source_edition.value: replace synthetic factors by a named public family and edition per category and keep the table shape

policy.esg.materiality.value: no numeric cut-off now; include a category when it is above 5 percent of the inventory or a customer asks (the 5 percent is a placeholder and must be labelled)

policy.esg.project_site_fuel_scope.value: project site fuel bought by Halvaro stays in scope 1; a customer may count it in its scope 3

policy.esg.reporting_basis.value: voluntary report for customers; Danish statutory statement for the Danish entity only if the Danish Financial Statements Act knowledge base confirms it; CSRD stated as not applicable (VERIFY)

policy.esg.reporting_boundary.value: operational control, both legal entities, six sites, fleet and plant; landlord supplied electricity at the Hamburg head office is in scope 2

policy.esg.restatement.value: restate comparatives when a factor set changes; the headline uses restated lines; originals are kept and disclosed in a bridge; no threshold

policy.esg.scope2_primary_method.value: always report both; the headline is location based because market based moves with certificates; show market based beside it

policy.esg.scope3_screening.value: in: 3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, 3.6 and 3.7; out with a reason: 3.2 capital goods (assets exist in finance, check) and 3.8 to 3.15

policy.esg.scoring_basis.value: current factor basis, location based scope 2, as-of date printed

policy.esg.scoring_external_use.value: no score leaves the company while factors are synthetic or a VERIFY fact is open

policy.esg.scoring_governance.value: the policy version is effective dated; scores are reproducible as of a date; a change needs General Counsel and CFO sign-off

policy.esg.scoring_indicators.value: seven: scope 1, scope 2 location, scope 3 and project intensity each against the glide path of the targets; renewable electricity share; EPD coverage of purchased goods; energy audit currency

policy.esg.scoring_missing_data.value: an indicator without data is listed and excluded; no overall score if less than 70 percent of the weight is present

policy.esg.scoring_pillars.value: environment only; social and governance are listed as not scored, no indicator definition

policy.esg.scoring_purpose.value: phase 1 scores Halvaro itself (environment pillar) and reuses the supplier rating as given; no customer scoring

policy.esg.scoring_scale.value: indicator score 0 to 100, bands A at 80 and above, B at 60, C at 40, D below (same letters as the supplier rating)

policy.esg.scoring_thresholds.value: score is achieved reduction over required reduction on the straight line from baseline year to target year, clipped to 0 to 100; share indicators are linear from 0 to 100 percent

policy.esg.scoring_weights.value: equal weights, with a sensitivity table; no empirical basis for others

policy.esg.synthetic_label.value: label every table and figure while any used factor row has synthetic true

policy.esg_report.signoff_role.value: Chief Financial Officer, on the proposal of the Sustainability specialist

policy.exposure.definition.value: added cost to completion is the open remaining quantity plus open free reservations at the price step; the cumulative price exposure is the profit and loss effect figure and stays separate

policy.governance.battle_review_record.value: the review note of the monthly battle review, kept by the Chief of staff

policy.governance.department_goal_approv.value: the executive team of Halvaro Infra, chaired by the Chief Executive Officer

policy.governance.document_approver.grou.value: the owner of the group policy that the standard applies

policy.governance.document_approver.loca.value: the head of the department where the procedure applies

policy.governance.document_approver.work.value: the team lead of the team that uses the instruction

policy.governance.goal_proposal_record.value: the goal proposal that the forum that approves the goal signs, kept by the Chief of staff together with the cascade

policy.governance.multi_battle_status_ow.value: the owner of the battle named first in the Battle column of the goal row; for a goal that reads all, the Chief of staff

policy.grid.cold_snap.value: found from the daily minimum temperature: at least 2 consecutive days at or below minus 8 degrees C in the zone; never from configured dates

policy.grid.fault_cluster.value: linking distance 300 m between element midpoints, at least 8 faults in the window, hull buffered by 150 m for membership of in-service elements of the faulted types

policy.grid.heat_load_limit.value: the data has no heat load alarm; as a KB value, warning at 90 percent and critical at 100 percent of design capacity, one hour minimum run

policy.grid.raw_retention_years.value: 3 years of raw 15 minute data, then hourly; functions report the resolution they got and never mix

policy.grid.repeat_fault_window.value: a repeat fault is a fault on the same element within 45 days of the previous fault

policy.grid.strained_element.value: in service and (load strained or age strained); load: own valid peak at or above 90 percent of the rated value, unknown when the element has no sensor; age: condition class D or E, or age 40 years or more; for the switchgear link only substations and transformer stations; report load, age and either separately

policy.grid.winter_window.value: December to February for fault comparisons, November to March for the peak per winter label; baseline is all months before the window from the start of the data

policy.grid.zone_percent_electric.value: no zone percent for the electric zone; report the highest station percent and station days above the station limit; never rank electric against heat on one scale

policy.holiday.de_forfeiture_display.value: show the balance after the German carry-over deadline (legal.DE.holiday.carryover.deadline_month_day) with a flag, never zero it automatically

policy.holiday.leave_record_creator.value: the HR business partner creates the leave record

policy.holiday.part_time_accrual.value: days are not pro rated by fte, as in the data

policy.intercompany.sales_price_basis.value: the standard cost of the item in the item master of the selling company, plus a markup that is fixed once a year with the budget

policy.intercompany.sales_record.value: the trade position of the selling company with Halvaro Inc. in finance.intercompany_balance, matched in finance-reporting.intercompany_match

policy.pay_equity.correction_deadline.value: deadline set by the pay transparency rules for correcting an unexplained pay difference; legal value, check against the law knowledge base: VERIFY

policy.pay_gap.action_route.value: HR analytics sends the flagged cells to the Chief Human Resources Officer, who decides on action with legal counsel

policy.pay_gap.controls.value: grade (one indicator per grade, not the level number), tenure years, legal entity

policy.pay_gap.pay_measure.value: monthly base salary per FTE in EUR, no bonus or allowances

policy.procurement.outside_framework_lab.value: in the order note of the purchase order in HalBuy; the data holds no column for the note, so an empty con_key is the only trace

policy.service.clock.value: service hours: working days from 07:00 to 16:00 local time

policy.service.priority_basis.critical.value: supply to customers is cut and not yet restored, or people are in danger

policy.service.priority_basis.high.value: supply is cut for some customers or at risk, or a main asset is out of service

policy.service.priority_basis.low.value: no loss of supply or function, and the work can wait for a planned visit

policy.service.priority_basis.medium.value: supply is kept but a function is degraded or a redundancy is lost

policy.short_stock.claim_order.value: 1 an open fault ticket of priority critical, 2 an open fault ticket of priority high, 3 a project reservation needed within the next 14 days, 4 any other open fault ticket, 5 any other project reservation, 6 stock kept for planned maintenance

policy.speakup.feedback_deadline.value: deadline for giving feedback on a report; legal value, check against the law knowledge base: VERIFY

policy.staffing.experience_ranking.value: rank by total hours on the comparables (both bases, hours by basis shown), lead roles flagged, leavers shown but not staffable

policy.staffing.utilisation_basis.value: project hours over availability net of leave and public holidays, population limited to project roles

policy.tender.limit_read_stage.value: at the opportunity stage qualification, before the opportunity moves to the stage tender

policy.version_approval.estimate_approve.value: tender: Commercial Director; budget: Director Project Delivery for Denmark and Managing Director GmbH for Germany; forecast: Project manager; final: Chief Financial Officer
